snippet.description:
BLACKSHARD is OUT! → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223390/BLACKSHARD/

Wander through a strange megastructure, the Labyrinth, to unravel its mysteries... Your behavior within the maze will define the outcome of your journey. What path will you choose to take?
